labelTitle: COLGATE OPTIC WHITE RENEWAL REVITALIZING WHITE GLISTENING MINT
quick: All FDA label sections are shown verbatim below

label.Active ingredient: Active ingredient Sodium Monofluorophosphate 0.76% (0.12% w/v fluoride ion)
label.Other label text:
Drug Facts
Dist. by: Colgate-Palmolive Company New York, NY 10022 U.S.A.
label.Dosage and administration: Directions adults and children 2 years of age and older brush teeth thoroughly, preferably after each meal or at least twice a day, or as directed by a dentist or physician children 2 to 6 years use only a pea sized amount and supervise child's brushing and rinsing (to minimize swallowing) children under 2 years ask a dentist or physician
label.Warnings: Warnings Keep out of reach of children under 6 years of age. If more than used for brushing is accidentally swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
